pages.title: Crystals of Attunement
pages.text: Over time, five distinct Crystal alignments were unearthed—each channeling a different aspect of Mythos energy. Each crystal does more than modify Mythos; they anchor it, shaping raw energy into usable forms.

pages.title: Crystal Fire
pages.text: The fuel of ambition. Volatile and unstable, it drives machines and consumes like flame. Often feared, it is essential in activating advanced constructs.

pages.title: Crystal Memory
pages.text: The root of the world. Earth-bound, steady, and old. It connects to the natural order and is vital for restoration, growth, and balance.

pages.title: Crystal Oath
pages.text: The sun's promise. Embodying resolve, radiance, and clarity, it shines brightest when used to strengthen or defend. A favored energy among guardians.

pages.title: Crystal Woe
pages.text: The echo of decay. This corrupted energy weakens, seeps, and deconstructs. A remnant of deep sorrow and ancient loss, aligned with water and emotional fragility.

pages.title: Crystal Grief
pages.text: The abyss gazes back. This lunar, cold magic draws from shadows and silence. It's often avoided by common folk, but necessary for rituals in the dark.
